extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Taurus asks for the microphone only when you tap Talk.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Taurus uses the camera only while Look is open, and sends one frame to your AI when you tap Send.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Taurus reads today's and tomorrow's events to show your schedule and ring before meetings. It never changes your calendars.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Taurus reads today's and tomorrow's events to show your schedule and ring before meetings. It never changes your calendars.
extendInfo.NSContactsUsageDescription: Taurus reads your contacts to know who people are when you ask about them or message them.
extendInfo.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Taurus can find and attach a photo when you ask.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Taurus reads and adds reminders when you ask.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Taurus reads and adds reminders when you ask.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Taurus can see your Bluetooth devices, such as headphones, for your Home and music.
extendInfo.NSLocationUsageDescription: Taurus uses your location for weather, travel times and what's nearby.
extendInfo.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Taurus uses your location for weather, travel times and what's nearby.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Taurus can use the Mac's own speech recognition as a backup when you talk to him.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Taurus opens, switches and controls apps for you when you ask, such as Messages, Notes and Music.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Taurus finds and opens files on your Desktop when you ask.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Taurus finds and opens your documents when you ask.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Taurus finds and opens your downloads when you ask.
extendInfo.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Taurus plays and controls your music when you ask.
